import bpy,json
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
cap=root/'captures/shipyard_bank_integration_20261115'
craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
rows=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 if o.type!='MESH':continue
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
 rows.append({'name':o.name,'min':[round(min(v[i] for v in pts),4) for i in range(3)],'max':[round(max(v[i] for v in pts),4) for i in range(3)],'verts':len(o.data.vertices),'faces':len(o.data.polygons),'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials if m],'props':{k:o[k] for k in o.keys() if isinstance(o[k],(str,int,float))},'uv':[u.name for u in o.data.uv_layers],'modifiers':[[m.name,m.type] for m in o.modifiers]})
(cap/'source_before.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
names=['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank']
for n in names:
 o=bpy.data.objects[n]
 print(n, 'attributes',[(a.name,a.domain,a.data_type) for a in o.data.attributes])
for m in bpy.data.materials:
 if any(w in m.name for w in ['M14','M15','S15']) and m.use_nodes:
  print('MAT',m.name,'BASE',[(n.name,tuple(n.inputs['Base Color'].default_value),n.inputs['Roughness'].default_value) for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED'],'IMAGES',[(n.name,n.image.name if n.image else None) for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='TEX_IMAGE'])
print('SAVED',len(rows),'objects',bpy.data.filepath)
